items.quote: And God said unto Abraham, Let it not be grievous in thy sight because of the lad, and because of thy bondwoman; in all that Sarah hath said unto thee, hearken unto her voice; for in Isaac shall thy seed be called.
items.claim: God commanded Abraham not to grieve over the lad and bondwoman, to obey Sarah's words, and declared that Abraham's seed shall be called in Isaac.
items.object: Abraham, the lad, bondwoman, seed, Isaac
